summary_ja: 事業法人等向けエクスポージャーのEAD(オン・バランス資産項目の下限、レポ形式取引等の勘案、オフ・バランス資産項目の掛目、下限、準用規定)を定める。
summary_en: Sets EAD for corporate, etc. exposures: the on-balance-sheet floor, credit risk mitigation recognized in EAD, credit conversion factors for off-balance-sheet items, EAD floors and mutatis mutandis rules.
paragraphs: The EAD for on-balance sheet asset items used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for corporate, etc. exposures shall be an amount not lower than the sum of the amount by which capital would decrease if that exposure were written off in full, specific loan loss provisions, the partial direct write-off amount, and, where a defaulted purchased receivable was purchased at a discount, the amount of that discount (limited to that which does not require refund).

Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may, applying Article 59, Article 64, Articles 67 through 84, Article 93, Article 104 and Articles 106 through 108 mutatis mutandis, take into account in EAD the effects of the credit risk mitigation techniques listed in the following items. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in those provisions shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach". (i) Eligible financial collateral (limited to repo-style transactions, margin lending and similar overseas transactions). (ii) Netting of loans and deposits.

The EAD for off-balance sheet asset items used by an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for revolving exposures among corporate, etc. exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the undrawn amount of the credit facility by an estimate of the credit conversion factor, or the amount estimated directly from the credit facility; provided, however, that where a credit conversion factor of 100% applies to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach, it shall be the amount obtained by multiplying by 100% as the credit conversion factor, and where it does not fall under the extension of credit as a revolving exposure, it shall be the amount calculated by the method provided in paragraph (5).

Notwithstanding paragraph (1) and the preceding paragraph, the total of EAD for on-balance sheet asset items and off-balance sheet asset items used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for corporate exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied shall be no less than the sum of the total EAD of on-balance sheet asset items and the amount obtained by multiplying by 50% the credit equivalent amount of the off-balance sheet transactions provided in Article 45.

The EAD for off-balance sheet asset items used by an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for corporate, etc. exposures means the amount obtained by multiplying the lower of the undrawn amount of the credit facility or the amount taking into account the upper limit of available credit according to the cash flow reported by the obligor and other restrictions on use, by the credit conversion factor listed in the upper column of the table in Article 45, paragraph (1) or (2); provided, however, that where there is a commitment to provide a credit facility, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall apply the lower of the applicable credit conversion factors.

Where, among the off-balance sheet asset items of revolving exposures to corporates, etc., only the credit extended that has already been drawn is transferred as the underlying asset of a securitization transaction, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall estimate EAD taking into account the possibility of additional drawdowns for the entire undrawn portion corresponding to the drawn credit transferred, and calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets using that EAD.

The provisions of Articles 46 through 54 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the EAD of corporate, etc. exposures. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in those provisions shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach".

The provisions of paragraph (5) shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach estimates the EAD for off-balance sheet asset items used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for corporate, etc. exposures that do not fall under corporate, etc. exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach" in that paragraph shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach", and "corporate, etc. exposures" as "corporate, etc. exposures (excluding corporate, etc. exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied)".

The provisions of paragraph (5) shall apply mutatis mutandis where, in some business units or asset categories among corporate, etc. exposures to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied, the minimum requirements provided in the following Section for the estimation of EAD are not satisfied, and the EAD used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for the exposures included in that business unit or asset category is set. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach" in that paragraph shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach".
